facts.text: The Cape sits on a bluff above Monuments Beach, a local surf break.
facts.excerpt: The Cape sits on a bluff above Monuments Beach, the local surf break that draws board-toting regulars from dawn to dusk.

facts.text: The hotel is on the tourist corridor between Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo.
facts.excerpt: Set on the tourist corridor between Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas look out to El Arco and Bahia Cabo San Lucas.
facts.excerpt: offers uninterrupted vistas of El Arco and the shimmering Bahia Cabo San Lucas

facts.text: The hotel has a saltwater pool carved into natural rock.
facts.excerpt: the saltwater pool carved into natural rock

facts.text: One of the pools is an infinity pool with a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: a lively infinity option with a swim-up bar

facts.text: Manta was conceived by Michelin-starred Mexican chef Enrique Olvera and designed by JSa Arquitectura.
facts.excerpt: Manta — conceived by Michelin-starred Mexican Chef Enrique Olvera and designed by JSa Arquitectura

facts.text: Manta celebrates Pacific Coast cultures, taking inspiration from Mexico, Peru, Japan and beyond.
facts.excerpt: Manta celebrates the Pacific Coast cultures, taking inspiration from Mexico, Peru, Japan and beyond

facts.text: The Ledge pairs modern Mexican and traditional American cooking by the beach.
facts.excerpt: Modern Mexican meets traditional American by the beach.

facts.text: The Ledge is known for its Cape Toast and a Sunday brunch with live music.
facts.excerpt: Don’t miss our famous Cape Toast or Sunday brunch with a food station and live music.

facts.text: The Rooftop has open-air bars, al fresco dining, sunken communal seating and a fire pit.
facts.excerpt: This signature space features open-air bars, al fresco dining, sunken communal seating, a fire pit, and serene water features

facts.text: Live acoustic music plays at sunset on The Rooftop, and DJs are on regular rotation.
facts.excerpt: Live acoustic music is played to the setting sun, and DJs are on regular rotation

facts.text: Sunken Bar sits in the center of the open-air lobby.
facts.excerpt: the revamped Sunken bar is a captivating haven in the center of the open air lobby

facts.text: Point Break is located at the main pool.
facts.excerpt: Located at our main pool, Point Break blends Baja-inspired flavors with a lively social atmosphere

facts.text: Currents Spa is set within natural rock formations.
facts.excerpt: Set within natural rock formations, the spa blends ocean views, soft light and the rhythm of the waves

facts.text: Currents Spa has al fresco cabanas, hot and cold plunge pools, a steam room and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: From al fresco cabanas to hot and cold plunge pools, steam room, sauna and a private couples treatment room

facts.text: Currents Spa offers daily wellness classes and a dedicated wellness concierge.
facts.excerpt: Currents Spa offers tailored treatments, daily high and low impact wellness classes and a dedicated wellness concierge

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies with a hanging daybed.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy sweeping ocean views from your private balcony, complete with a hanging daybed

facts.text: Interiors feature mid-century Latin American furnishings and custom sateen-woven linens.
facts.excerpt: Inside, mid-century Latin American furnishings and custom sateen-woven linens add a refined, personal touch.

facts.text: The one-, two- and three-bedroom villas have full kitchens and plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: our one-, two- and three-bedroom villas feature full kitchens, plunge pools

facts.text: The Cape opened in 2015.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 2015, The Cape is Hyatt’s Thompson Hotels brand at its most refined.

facts.text: The hotel is a collaboration between Mexico City architect Javier Sanchez and interior designer Marisabel Gomez Vazquez.
facts.excerpt: It’s a collaboration between Mexico City architect Javier Sánchez and famed interior designer Marisabel Gómez Vázquez

facts.text: Glass Box boutique sells pieces from emerging Latin American designers who work with artisans.
facts.excerpt: sophisticated pieces from emerging Latin American designers who work hand in hand with artisans to create unique designs

facts.text: The Cape is pet-friendly, with restrictions.
facts.excerpt: The Cape, a Thompson Hotel, is a pet-friendly hotel; restrictions apply.

facts.text: Valet parking is free for registered hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance for registered hotel guests. Includes in-and-out privileges.

facts.text: The hotel can arrange private airport transfers.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel can arrange private airport transfers.

facts.text: Monuments Beach below the hotel is a surf spot and not really swimmable.
facts.excerpt: Directly below, Monuments Beach is a true surfers’ haunt; it’s not really swimmable

facts.text: The spa is on the smaller side.
facts.excerpt: Tucked quietly away from the social pulse of the hotel, the spa is on the smaller side.

facts.text: The pool bar and open-air lobby play music into the night.
facts.excerpt: The pool bar and open-air lobby pump out smooth beats into the night

facts.text: The hotel achieved Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: Recently, the hotel achieved Green Key certification

facts.text: The Cape is a luxury boutique hotel that redefines the resort experience.
facts.excerpt: The Cape is a luxury boutique hotel that redefines the resort experience with bold design, effortless style and panoramic views

facts.text: Manta serves seafood from chef Enrique Olvera's exhibition-style kitchen.
facts.excerpt: From Manta, where seafood and artistic expression merge from within chef Enrique Olvera’s dynamic exhibition-style kitchen
